metadata.description: The swarm-routing org's agent skills: one Claude Code plugin, swarm-routing, whose skills follow the Agent Skills spec (skills/<name>/SKILL.md), so `npx skills add swarm-routing/skills` installs the same skills in any agent.

plugins.name: swarm-routing
plugins.description: Skills for building and maintaining the swarm-routing ns-3 protocols and their org: org-repo, fidelity-sheet, protocol-review, docs-review, pr-shepherd, lit-search, references, token-audit, bestpractices, dependency-bump, release, sonar-triage; plus swarm-mcp, a local read-only MCP server (.mcp.json: swarm-routing/swarm-mcp at the commit swarm-mcp.lock pins) giving the fidelity, protocol-review, release and release-lock verdicts as MCP tools; ns-3-specific skills carry the ns3- prefix.
